title: Re:Zero Deaths
description: Adds two Re:Zero Death SFX to the game! Immediate Respawn and Keep Inventory are toggled on for a scarier/funnier effect!
body: Adds two iconic death sound effects inspired by Re:Zero to Minecraft, making every death feel more dramatic, unsettling, or hilarious depending on the situation. For the best experience, this pack is designed to be used with **Immediate Respawn** and **Keep Inventory** enabled, allowing the sound effects to play while you instantly return to the game. Whether you're creating a Re:Zero-themed playthrough, trolling your friends, or just want a more memorable death screen experience, this simple sound pack adds extra personality to every fatal mistake.
